title: Every validation error, and what to do about it
hook: Before a node runs, the server checks the whole graph. It can refuse in seventeen ways. Each one, with its real text and its fix.

verified.claim: The error text in the table is what validate_prompt returned here, for the errors marked as run.
verified.ref: execution.py:validate_prompt, in process on a CPU with core nodes

verified.claim: The list of error types is complete for execution.py, validation.py and the server's prompt route at v0.43.0.
A graph with one good output and one bad one still runs the good one, and reports the bad one in node_errors.
The top-level details are empty when the error sits upstream of the output, so node_errors is where to look.
A bad prompt gets HTTP 400 with error and node_errors.
Core's LoadImage reports a missing file through custom_validation_failed.

unchecked: exception_during_inner_validation can also come from a raising upstream validator. We triggered it only with a wire to a missing node and a wire to a missing slot.
How the editor shows each error (red outlines and the dialog) isn't tested here. We read the server's replies.
